name: Sakazaki Yuuya
source:
Yuuya is the older half-brother of Sakuya, and also a [URL=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fantail_%28pigeon%29]Fantail Pigeon[/URL]. Infamous in St. Pigeonation for being a big flirt, he often misses his classes. Despite his lack of attendance, he can be seen frequently helping out the school's infirmary as Shuu's assistant.

[Based on the [URL=http://clione.halfmoon.jp/hatoful-boyfriend/character/yuya.html]official website[/URL]]
